One person found this helpful Report 4.0 out of 5 stars A Fun, Low-Power ‘Lottery’ Miner That’s Easy to Live With Reviewed in the United States on January 22, 2026A Fun, Low-Power ‘Lottery’ Miner That’s Easy to Live WithProsCompact 1TH/s BM1366 unit runs around 25W, so it doesn’t heat up my office.Built-in 2.4G Wi-Fi made setup simple—no Ethernet cable across the room.Surprisingly quiet for a miner; the fan is more “laptop hum” than “server roar.”Supports a bunch of SHA-256 coins; I mainly run BTC, but it’s nice having options.ConsSolo mode is exactly what it sounds like: the odds of finding a block are tiny, so treat it as a hobby, not income.Instructions are a bit generic, and 2.4G only means you may need to be near your router.Final recommendationI bought this to scratch the “I want to mine” itch without the noise, power draw, and wiring of a full-size ASIC. It solved that problem immediately: plug it in, join my Wi-Fi, point it at a pool, and it just runs. The web dashboard is straightforward for checking hashrate and temps, and it’s been stable for multi-day runs. I appreciate it doesn’t trip my breaker and I can monitor it from my phone. If you want a compact, low-power SHA-256 toy that’s genuinely easy to set up, I recommend it—just keep expectations realistic 5.0 out of 5 stars Read me Reviewed in the United States on October 5, 2025Okay bought this as a fun stash in the corner and not by lottery tickets anymore. Set up is a bit confusing! I’m currently using the pool.io because it lets you see the activity and make sure you’re mining. Once it connects you can’t pull up that interface anymore so not much of a way to track the hash rates or progress. IMPORTANT!!! You need a router it is different, got one for 21$ from Walmart needs to be 2.4 or 5 it’ll say on the box. On that note when you reset and save your progress PUNCH THE RESET BEHIND THE BOX FOR IT TO TAKE AFFECT. If you don’t you’ll be spinning your wheels and ready to throw the box across the room. Don’t worry about the password it’s usually just X or 123 so for those that are struggling.After all that you’ll be good and can just track from your phone on whatever pool you’re using. Also WiFi passwords cannot have any unique bs like @!?
